Wi-Fi and content

Changing Wi-Fi may disconnect this page. USB setup can report the new address. Time synchronizes through NTP when the device has network access.
Display a frame
Upload a 296 × 152 monochrome frame: 5,624 bytes, MSB first, 1 = white. The rightmost 16 columns are reserved when the status bar is enabled.

Upload an application .bin image. Keep USB connected until the device restarts.
